papers.title: Thermal behavior and grain growth orientation during selective laser melting of Ti-6Al-4V alloy

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究Ti-6Al-4V合金选区激光熔化过程中的热行为和晶粒取向，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或生物力学性能。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure, no mechanical testing for implant applications, no fatigue or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM成型Ti-6Al-4V合金的热行为与晶粒取向演化规律
summary_zh.method: 通过实验观察与热模拟分析不同工艺参数下的温度场和晶粒生长
summary_zh.result: 揭示了热历史对晶粒取向和微观组织的调控机制
summary_zh.validation: 实验验证与热模拟结果对比

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the thermal behavior and grain growth orientation during selective laser melting of Ti-6Al-4V alloy.
summary_en.method: Experimental characterization combined with thermal simulation to analyze temperature fields and grain evolution under different processing parameters.
summary_en.result: The relationship between thermal history and grain orientation/microstructure was established.
summary_en.validation: Experimental observations were compared with thermal simulation results for validation.
